answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in terrace, expire in hollow, and harbor lists each expiry. An farming party running 36 aliases as a result needs 81 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4784 identities would post 1498 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
